ai_summary: Adani Energy Solutions Limited has acquired 100% equity in Satara Power Transmission Limited (SPTL), a newly incorporated Special Purpose Vehicle, for a nominal cost of Rs. 1 lakh. This strategic acquisition enables AESL to proceed with the previously announced Rs. 4,700 crore inter-regional transmission project for renewable energy evacuation in Maharashtra and Karnataka. While the acquisition cost is minimal, it is standard for project SPVs won via competitive bidding, indicating a planned strategic move rather than a financial red flag.
